metaShifts.description: The systematic nerf to Sange's Health Restoration (16%→12%) cascades through all Sange-based items (Abyssal Blade, SnY, KnS all 20%→16%), creating a fundamental shift away from sustain-based itemization. Combined with Crude neutral item nerfs and Consecrated Wraps changes from 7.41a, this eliminates the healing amplification meta entirely.

Building on 7.41a's Mana Burned as Damage buff, the Mana Break max burn increase (4%→4.5% at max level) creates a compounding effect. AM now burns more mana AND converts more of it to damage, making him the definitive counter to intelligence cores in a meta where sustain options are systematically removed.

Gleipnir's radius buffs (275→325 base, 350→400 effective) combined with Conjurer's Catalyst massive damage buffs (40→80 hero damage, 100→200 threshold) create a new control-oriented itemization path. This synergizes with heroes who can proc spell effects consistently.

Chaos Knight (Phantasm damage 100%→50/75/100%, cooldown 75s→85/80/75s), Shadow Demon (Disruption illusion duration 11/12/13/14s→8/10/12/14s), and Meepo (multiple nerfs including TP cooldown sharing removal) face coordinated nerfs that eliminate illusion-based strategies from viability.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Mana Break's increased burn rate (4%→4.5%) synergizes with Conjurer's Catalyst's doubled damage output (40→80 from heroes). Each Mana Break hit can now trigger significantly more spell damage, creating a devastating combination for AM players who secure this neutral item.

Gleipnir's increased radius (275→325) combined with Conjurer's Catalyst buffs creates a powerful control combo. Heroes like Tinker (Deploy Turrets missile speed buff) and Invoker (additional ability points at 6/12/18) can consistently proc the enhanced Catalyst damage within Gleipnir's improved AoE.

synergisticWinners.entity: Phantom Assassin + Coup de Grace Scaling
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: PA's critical damage increase (400%→450% at max) combined with Phantom Strike duration buff (2.5s→3s) and strength gain improvement creates a mid-game power spike that capitalizes on the removal of Sange-based sustain items from enemy cores.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The coordinated nerfs to Sange (16%→12%) and all derivative items (Abyssal, SnY, KnS all 20%→16%) eliminate the sustain-based itemization path that many carries relied on. Heroes like Wraith King, Lifestealer, and Sven lose their primary survivability scaling option.

The double nerf of Phantasm damage scaling (100%→50/75/100%) and increased cooldown (75s→85/80/75s) destroys CK's power curve. Even with 3 illusions at all levels, the reduced damage output makes his ultimate significantly weaker in team fights.

The removal of TP cooldown sharing combined with item stat penalties now applying to health/mana bonuses fundamentally breaks Meepo's scaling. His ability to leverage item advantages across multiple units is severely compromised, making him unviable in competitive play.

Carry.explanation: Mana Break max burn increase (4%→4.5%) amplifies the 7.41a damage conversion buff, creating the strongest mana-burning carry in the game. With sustain items nerfed across the board, AM's ability to punish intelligence cores becomes unmatched.

Critical damage buff (400%→450%), Phantom Strike duration increase (2.5s→3s), and strength gain improvement (2.0→2.2) create a powerful mid-game spike. Benefits from enemies losing access to Sange-based sustain items.

Movement speed buff (300→305), Bladeform scaling improvement (0.05%→0.1% per level), and Blade Fury talent buff (+100→+120 DPS) continue the aggressive carry trend from 7.41a, making him a dominant laning and fighting carry.

Mid.explanation: Additional ability points at levels 6/12/18 provide unprecedented spell access and scaling. Combined with Gleipnir radius buffs and Conjurer's Catalyst improvements, Invoker becomes the premier spell-based mid laner.

Deploy Turrets missile speed increase (1200→1350) and instant activation (0.3s→0s) improve his teamfight presence. Synergizes well with Gleipnir buffs and can effectively utilize Conjurer's Catalyst procs.

Offlane.explanation: Flesh Heap strength gain increase (1.6→2.0 per stack) provides significantly better scaling in extended games. Benefits from the removal of enemy sustain options, making his damage more impactful.
Agility gain buff (2.0→2.2) and damage scaling improvement (3.2→3.3 per level) enhance his core potential. Can effectively utilize Gleipnir's improved radius for better Reverse Polarity setups.

SoftSupport.explanation: Holy Persuasion damage bonus increase (0/6/12/18%→5/10/15/20%) significantly improves his creep scaling and jungle control. Benefits from Helm of the Overlord buffs (45s→40s cooldown, 1800→1900 min health).

HardSupport.explanation: Hammer of Purity heal increase (30%→35%), Guardian Angel duration buff (4/4.5/5s→4/4.75/5.5s), and Degen Aura talent improvement (+125→+150 radius) make him a premier defensive support in a damage-heavy meta.

Carry.explanation: Phantasm damage nerf (100%→50/75/100%) and cooldown increase (75s→85/80/75s) destroy his teamfight impact. Even with 3 illusions at all levels, the reduced damage makes his ultimate significantly weaker.

Multiple devastating nerfs: TP cooldown sharing removal, item stat penalties now affecting health/mana, movement speed reduction (315→310), strength gain decrease (2.2→2.0), and MegaMeepo nerfs (60s→90s cooldown, 25s→20s duration) make him unviable.
Strength gain reduction (2.4→2.3) and Dispersion radius nerf (800→700) reduce both her survivability and teamfight presence. Loses access to Sange-based sustain builds that were core to her scaling.

Mid.explanation: Base damage reduction (-3, making level 1 damage 52-56) and Sleight of Fist mana cost increase (60/65/70/75→75) hurt his laning and farming efficiency. Cannot effectively utilize the new item synergies.
Dissimilate damage nerf (120/200/280/360→105/185/265/345) reduces his burst potential significantly. The 15-damage reduction per level makes his mid-game power spike much weaker.

Offlane.explanation: Base strength reduction (26→25), damage decrease (51-57→50-56), and multiple talent nerfs weaken his laning phase. Leviathan's Catch change (fish every level→every even level) reduces his scaling consistency.
Base attack speed reduction (100→90), Wild Axes duration rescaling, and multiple talent nerfs (+5→+4 armor, +2%→+1.5% damage amp) significantly weaken his laning dominance and scaling.

SoftSupport.explanation: Disruption illusion duration nerf (11/12/13/14s→8/10/12/14s) and movement speed talent reduction (+25→+20) reduce his utility and positioning. The illusion nerf particularly hurts his teamfight contribution.
Vendetta duration reduction (60s→45/50/55s) significantly limits his roaming potential and pick-off capability. The reduced invisibility window makes him less effective at creating map pressure.

HardSupport.explanation: Crystal Clone cooldown increase (10s→12s) reduces her survivability tool availability. In a meta focused on burst damage and reduced sustain, this makes her even more vulnerable.
Intelligence gain reduction (3.5→3.3) hurts his mana scaling and spell damage progression. Reduces his effectiveness as a damage-dealing support in the current meta trend.
